title: Sentinel SAST CVEFixes Dataset Feature Ingestion
summary: Extracted NLOC, cyclomatic complexity, AST nesting depth, and TF-IDF features from CVEFixes v1.0.7 dataset for Python vulnerability classification model.
experiment: Automated AST parsing pipeline across 10,000+ vulnerable and patched Python functions.
observation: Structural metrics alone reduced false positive rate by 34% compared to pure TF-IDF statistical models.
result: Trained calibrated Logistic Regression model with security guardrails.
lesson: Fusing structural AST features with statistical text representations creates significantly more robust static analysis tools.

title: AgroSort AI Teach & Repeat Kinematics Loop
summary: Integrated virtual joystick web dashboard with ESP32 FreeRTOS tasks for 4-DOF robotic arm trajectory recording and playback.
experiment: Tested low-latency HTTP servo motor command loops over local ESP32 Wi-Fi Access Point.
observation: Separating PWM generation onto ESP32 Core 1 and HTTP parsing onto Core 0 eliminated motor stutter.
result: Achieved smooth multi-servo position recording and repeat execution.
lesson: Embedded dual-core task isolation is critical when combining real-time hardware actuation with web communication.

title: FBG Sensor Wavelength Shift Baseline Validation
summary: Ran classical statistical baseline calculations on experimental strain and temperature Bragg wavelength shift data.
experiment: Evaluated linear regression and multi-variable polynomial baseline models on experimental FBG sensor runs.
observation: Established baseline accuracy metrics: MAE 0.38 pm and RMSE 0.43 pm.
result: Constructed standardized experimental benchmark prior to physics-informed loss integration.
lesson: A deep learning model must always be evaluated against empirical classical baselines before claiming superiority.

title: Gravitational Battery Multi-Load Output Mapping
summary: Measured electromechanical energy recovery across 250g, 500g, 750g, and 1000g mass descent profiles.
experiment: Mapped dynamo output voltage curves against descent velocity and mass elevation height.
observation: Descent velocity regulation via stepper motor resistance prevented output spike damage.
result: Documented electromechanical efficiency loss factors in mechanical energy conversion.
lesson: Physical mechanical tolerances and motor back-EMF dictate practical energy recovery limits.
